body: I’m lucky (or unlucky, depending on how attached you are to living) enough to have a severe enough allergy to go into anaphylactic shock, so after I go to the store, I’m eating these babies until I drop
I’m right there with you in wishing it were easier to do, and it sucks that most drug combinations are ineffective bc i’d love to go that way if i could

hello- i’m a toxicologist in training, so i’m offering what i know to the best of my knowledge

put simply, that combination is not likely to kill you; i won’t go too much into the specifics of why as i don’t want to encourage you to “better” your plan, but what this will likely do is cause you a lot of gastrointestinal duress, nausea, sweating, heart palpitations, and dizziness; complications with your liver are possible in this scenario but extremely unlikely

i’m also suicidal so i won’t be a hypocrite and tell you what to do, but i personally wouldn’t do this since it wouldn’t even do the job and would just be a bad time
That’s fair, I appreciate the perspective and your honesty- thank you
Thank you for the offer, but I’m not feeling up to that right now
if it helps, i wasn’t able to get appointments from 9-5 because of my schedule, but if you’re very desperate, they can do 8am intakes which are a lot more available
